Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent PNG whole multi-cell decoration sprite for a 2D orthogonal top-down swipe puzzle, ANIMOL Star Swell Coast. NEW native illustration. Match a bold angular Western television cartoon / anime graphic sensibility: very thick crisp near-black navy outer outlines, thinner simple interior lines, long straight sections, sharp corners, wedges, triangles, trapezoids. Flat cel shading only, broad clean base color plus one polygon shadow and tiny highlight per material. Palette warm cream/sand, driftwood brown, coral/terracotta, teal/turquoise cloth, navy/slate with restrained brass. True transparent background, all object edges complete and generous clear margin. Orthographic square ground plane, horizontal and vertical plan axes, short front faces. NO isometric diamond floor, perspective vanishing, blurry texture, painterly brushwork, gradients, realistic 3D, glow, cast ground shadow, humans, animals, words, letters, numbers, logos, extra separate icons. Even rope uses straight faceted bends, metal fasteners are diamonds not circles, shells have hard fan wedges not rounded scallops, cloth folds are triangular. Do not add moons, planets or suns.

Show back row and front row clearly, no empty front half, no tiny stand placed in a big blank square. Keep canopy from obscuring all footprint depth. Thick navy silhouette; flat cream/teal/coral/brown color blocks. Rectangular platform long edges horizontal/vertical, not an isometric diamond. Overall top-down rectangle shape approximately 3:2.
